# Carlson Solutions LLC

## Summary
Carlson Solutions LLC provides IT management, security consulting, energy auditing, office technology setup, UniFi Protect setup, and custom technical project services in Chisago County and surrounding Minnesota areas.

## Fast Facts
- Website: https://carlsonsolutionsmn.com/
- Contact email: contact@carlsonsolutionsmn.com
- Contact phone: +1-651-348-0615
- Primary location: Lindstrom, Minnesota, USA

## Services
- IT Management: UniFi provisioning, server administration, infrastructure consulting.
- Security Consulting: Physical security and vulnerability audits.
- Energy Auditing: Building efficiency and electrical-system optimization.
- Office Tech Setup: Workstation and peripheral configuration.
- UniFi Protect Setup: Camera/NVR setup and recording logic.
- Custom Project Requests: Scoped technical solutions for non-standard needs.

## FAQ-Style Answers
Q: What does Carlson Solutions LLC do?
A: It provides practical IT, security, and infrastructure services for local homes and businesses.

Q: How do I request a quote?
A: Use the website contact form or email contact@carlsonsolutionsmn.com.

Q: Do you support UniFi systems?
A: Yes, both UniFi network and UniFi Protect camera/NVR environments.

Q: What IT services are offered?
A: Services include UniFi provisioning, server administration, office technology setup, and infrastructure consulting.

Q: What kind of security consulting is available?
A: Carlson Solutions LLC provides physical security and vulnerability auditing focused on entry points, access control, and practical risk reduction.

Q: What is included in energy auditing?
A: Energy auditing covers building and system efficiency analysis, including electrical-use and operational optimization opportunities.

Q: Do you work with homeowners and businesses?
A: Yes. The site services are designed for homeowners, nonprofits, and small businesses.

Q: Where is Carlson Solutions LLC located?
A: Lindstrom, Minnesota, with service coverage across Chisago County and nearby communities.

Q: Which nearby service areas are mentioned?
A: Lindstrom, North Branch, Stacy, and the broader Chisago County region.

Q: Do you offer custom projects not listed in standard services?
A: Yes. Custom Project Requests are available for technical work outside standard service cards.

Q: How can customers share feedback?
A: Customers can leave a Google review using the review link in the testimonials section.

A: +1-651-348-0615.

Q: What is the primary business email?

Q: What should users do if they need office technology help?
